description:
Legacy Waving Banners

Original forum thread

Notice of Acquisition
I got in touch with Zer0morph, he has been working under the name "Apostle Games" for 3.5 years as an indie developer on his next realease, Age of Tribulation (playtest currently available on steam). He kindly explained how to continue his mod and gave permission to take over.

Quote from: Zer0Morph on January 09, 2026, 01:03:49 PM
I AM...Zer0Morph, and I approve this message!  :o

Haha, well done Thecno! The new ones look fantastic and I'm honored you would carry the torch to the top of the mountain and allow me a seat at the table.
Thank you for doing this. God bless! 8)

A mod that turns all faction flags into wavy banners. It includes all the vanilla factions, some modded ones and some custom flags for players to choose from. The flags were created manually using Photoshop (Zer0morph) or GIMP (me) and artistic adjustments have been made to ensure that the flags remain visible on dark backgrounds. To enable the replacement of modded faction flags, the mod must be loaded first as Starsector does not overwrite files that have already been added during modloading. I named it accordingly to do so, please do not rename the mod in mod_info.json.

New Features:
- New mod support
- New design philosophy : favours changing the black background to dark grey to avoid altering the colour patterns completely but Zer0morph's original flags remain unchanged.
- Alternative flag versions : for a look that is more faithful to the original colour scheme. To use these, locate the file in the "Legacy Waving Banners/graphics" folder, delete the standard flag, and rename "flag_alt.png" by removing the "_alt" suffix.
- Vanilla-only version: includes only vanilla factions and custom player flags (see download badges above).

Mods supported :
Factions mods :
- Arma armatura by shoi
- Dassault-Mikoyan Engineering by Harmful Mechanic (withdrawn from the forum)
- Diable Avionics by Tartiflette & Caymon Joestar
- Emergent Threats/IX Revival by vicegrip
- Halo Dynamics Ship Industry by Ajimu, Contentment, Scythe & persocom01
- Iron Shell by Timid
- Interstellar Imperium by Dark.Revenant
- JaydeePiracy by Jaydee8652
- Kadur Remnant by Vayra
- Legacy of Arkgneisis (ARS) by Gwyvern
- Machina Void Shipyards by Unit9461
- Mayasuran Navy by Knight Chase
- Outer Rim Alliance by Tartiflette & Neodymium
- Phillip Andrada Gas Station Manager by WMGreywind
- Prv (Starworks corporation, Rust Belt) by prav
- Random Assortment of Things by Lukas04
- Roider Union by SafariJohn
- SCY by starficz
- ScalarTech Solutions by Nia Tahl
- Tahlan Shipworks (Legio Infernalis, Great Houses) by Nia Tahl
- Tiandong Heavy Industries by MesoTroniK
- The Knights of Ludd by Selkie, Dal, Starficz & P.M.Damon
- Underworld (Starlight Cabal) by Dark.Revenant
- United Aurora Federation by Ryxsen1421

Player flags :
- Terra Invicta inspired Flag Pack by Vexlia Artemiss

Permission / Asset Use (for modders) :
It is not intended to claim ownership of any original assets. All original flag designs and assets remain the property of their respective creators.
If you are a mod author and would prefer that your flags not be included or modified, please let me know and I will remove them. This project is shared in good faith and with respect for the Starsector modding community.

All Player-Made Faction modders and various artists from whom we redesigned their flags
And of course the original author Zer0Morph (aka Apostle Games) who is working on the release of Age of Tribulation (playtest currently available on steam)

gallery.aiCaption: A grid of eight faction flags featuring various emblems like a phoenix, triangles, and skulls.
A large vertical collage displaying dozens of different faction flag designs.
Another large grid showing a wide variety of faction flags with distinct symbols and colors.
Three specific faction banners displayed side-by-side: an orange phoenix emblem, a grey design with runes, and a red banner with a white symbol.
